Working together

One strategy doesn't
fit every brand

My strength is finding the right creators for your brand.

Every product, price point and audience needs a different mix of creators and content. Before we start, I want to understand what you need your affiliate program to achieve, because that shapes who we recruit, what they create and how we measure success.

What's the goal of your affiliate program?
1

Organic videos that convert

Authentic creator content that sells on TikTok and can be repurposed across your other platforms and ads.

2

Halo effect to DTC

Using TikTok visibility to lift brand awareness and drive customers to your website and other sales channels.

3

Sales on TikTok Shop

Growing GMV directly on TikTok Shop through creators, content volume and winning videos.

The brands I work best with invest in growth

TikTok's dynamics mean organic sales are absolutely possible, and I've delivered them. But the strongest results come from pairing great creators with the right support behind them.

I prefer to partner with brands that have budget for:

GMV Max campaignsRetainer creator programsCreator incentives
How I work

From zero affiliates
to a creator engine

01

Find the right creators

Targeted outreach on and off TikTok, matching creators to the product, price point and audience.
